scope: Actual task, reference, script and generated-manuscript file reads, ordered by first access. Ordinary Python/PowerShell runtime library and OS accesses are not source-material loads and are not enumerated. No other runs, repository evaluation/development reports or installed skills were inspected.
encoding: UTF-8: Get-Content -Encoding UTF8 for source reads; rg searched UTF-8 text; Python reads/writes specify utf-8. Every Python invocation used -X utf8 -B.

model_and_settings.visible_identity_statement: Runtime instructions describe the assistant as Codex based on GPT-6.
